text:
maria: Quick async check-in

maria: DONE: rolled the small nginx config tweak to reduce 503s for /generate route, validated on staging. Also ran a quick health sweep on KV cache hit rates.
maria: BLOCKER: SLO alert is still flapping for `generate_lat_p95` — looks like bursts during model warmup. Pager fired twice overnight. :grimacing:
maria: TODAY: open a follow-up ticket to adjust warmup/jitter and put a temporary routing fallback to smaller model if latency > 700ms. Need someone from runtime to sanity-check the fallback logic.

akshay: thx for the heads up. can you paste the alert graph? wondering if this is one noisy customer or broader.

maria: pasted small snippet below (from quick dashboard) — overall p95 spiked to ~890ms for ~6mins at 03:12 UTC; correlated with a batch of long-context requests. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/alerts/generate_lat_p95 (internal)

devon: I can pick up the ticket. I want to try a short-term mitigation: enable prefix KV warming for models that see > 1.5s cold-starts and add a per-route soft-throttle for large-context requests.

olivia: +1 on warming. also would like telemetry added to the rollback path so we can see how often fallback model returns lower quality. we can use the eval-metrics flow to log a sample.

sam: oncall FYI — if this escalates we'll want to mute the noisy alert and rely on synthetic checks until the fix is rolled, otherwise it'll keep paging.

ci-bot: deploy: staging/nginx-config-v2 succeeded (1918870030) :white_check_mark:

maria: @devon please add the soft-throttle config as a feature flag so we can flip it per-customer. put the ticket into "in progress" and link to the playbook paragraph on SLO noise: /playbooks/slo-noise.md

devon: ack, creating ticket now — https://tickets.redwood.ai/RED-3821

akshay: quick ask — do we have a cheap alert rule that counts unique customer IDs in a spike window? if not, we should add one to avoid chasing single-tenant spikes.

olivia: we dont. adding a queued task to generate `generate.lat.spike.unique_clients` via our alerting pipeline. will test on staging.

maria: thanks all. last note: if anyone on runtime/serving wants to pair on the fallback safety checks later today, ping me — I’ll be online after 13:30 PT. :coffee:

sam: got it, will watch the alert playbook and mute if needed.

maria: closing the loop here — I'll drop a short summary in the SLO channel after devon files the PR.
